message:
As we embrace the art of being prepared, it can be refreshing to reconnect with the basics of planning together as a family. The resource we’ve come across offers some excellent guidance on creating a family emergency plan. 

Let’s take a moment to think about how we can weave low-tech fun into this process: brainstorming ideas, mapping out our escape routes, or even creating a family safety playlist. It’s not just about being ready; it’s also about bringing us closer. 

What creative ways can we come up with to make preparedness a shared adventure? 🤔
